test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which union territory of India has a sea named after it?
solution:
Correct Answer **Andaman and Nicobar Islands**

The elongated chain of islands located in the Bay of Bengal extending from north to south is called Andaman and Nicobar islands. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**Andaman and Nicobar islands:

__
 
• Andaman and Nicobar Islands situated in the Bay of Bengal, run like a narrow chain in the north-south direction extending between 6° 45′ N to 13° 45′ N.
 
• This archipelago is composed of around 265 big and small islands (203 Andaman islands + 62 Nicobar Islands)
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar Islands extend from 6° 45′ N to 13° 45′ N and from 92° 10′ E to 94° 15′ E for a distance of about 590 km.
 
• The total area of this elongated island is 8,249 sq. km.
 
• The Andaman islands are divided into three main islands i.e. North, Middle, and South.
 
• Duncan's passage separates Little Andaman from South Andaman.
 
• The Great Andaman group of islands in the north is separated by the Ten Degree Channel from the Nicobar group in the south.
 
• The Grand Channel is between the Great Nicobar islands and the Sumatra islands of Indonesia.
 
• The Coco Strait is between the North Andaman islands and the Coco Islands of Myanmar.
 
• Port Blair, the capital of Andaman Nicobar Islands lies in the South Andaman.

 
• Among the Nicobar islands, the Great Nicobar is the largest.
 
• It is the southernmost island and is very close to Sumatra island of Indonesia.
 
• The Car Nicobar is the northernmost.
 
• Most of these islands are made of tertiary sandstone, limestone, and shale resting on basic and ultrabasic volcanoes.
 
• The Barren and Narcodam Islands, north of Port Blair, are volcanic islands

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Puducherry:

 
• There are total 4 Districts in Puducherry.
 
• The city is surrounded by Tamil Nadu state, on the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal, 105 miles (170 km) south of Chennai (Madras).
 
• The Union Territory of Puducherry has been formed consolidating four erstwhile French establishments viz Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam.
 
• Karaikal District is in the state of Tamil Nadu and is next to Puducherry in area and population. 
 
• Mahe is surrounded by the State of Kerala and Yanam by the state of Andra Pradesh.
 
• Yanam is one of the regions in the Union Territory of Puducherry which is 870 km away from it.
 
• The town of Yanam lies on the mouth of the Godavari River where it flows into the Bay of Bengal.

'Daman' is the capital of the Union Territory of Daman and Dadra and Nagar Haveli.

Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu are part of the union territory.
